prompt:

Asset type: one realistic 4:3 landscape image for a visual guessing game.
Input image 1 is the edit target: brass astrolabe.
Primary request: reframe to show the COMPLETE astrolabe with the entire suspension ring and any top knob clearly inside the frame, with at least 12% quiet background above it and below the disk. Display it resting upright on a small unobtrusive support; do not suspend it from a cropped chain. Preserve the brass disk, openwork star-pointer rete, central pivot, straight rotating sighting rule and circular engraved scales. Keep the warm study setting and light, but instrument should occupy only 70% of image height.
Constraints: no cropped instrument parts, no added labels, names, readable text, logos, watermark, tile lines or frames. The depiction is an identification illustration, not a precision astronomical diagram.

review.scope: Source image identity/anatomy/framing and actual12-tile jumble/reveal/hide gameplay for this specific question.
review.note: Corrected brass astrolabe is entirely inside frame including top knob and suspension ring; openwork rete, central pivot, rotating straight rule and circular engraved scales are visible. Engraving is illustrative, not a usable calibrated astronomical instrument.
